paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains open with 27 cases across 12 states and 5 hospitalizations reported [1]. Kayem Foods Inc. is recalling over 1.5 million pounds of ready-to-eat meat and poultry products due to possible temperature abuse, a Class I recall indicating serious health risk [2]. Consumers should not consume products bearing establishment numbers "EST. M/P 7839," "EST. P 20935A," or "EST. M 9520" [2].

Three additional recalls were issued this week [3][4][8]. Lidl US recalled Gelatelli Coffee & Vanilla Gelato due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [8]. Natural Grocers is recalling Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans for potential glass fragments [3]. WinCo Foods recalled WinCo Foods Brand Hoagie Rolls due to undeclared sesame [4]. Wild West Seed Inc. is recalling broccoli sprouting seeds for Salmonella contamination [10].
